evals.prompt: I have a NestJS app using Prisma with PostgreSQL and JWT auth. I want to add passkey support so users can sign in with their fingerprint instead of a password.
evals.expected_output: A backend migration plan covering: @simplewebauthn/server install, Prisma schema addition (passkeys table with credentialId, publicKey, counter, aaguid, passkeyUserId on User), 6 endpoints with correct auth guards, RP config from env vars, Redis challenge storage. Followed by a frontend plan with conditional UI setup.
assertions: Plan is presented before any code is written
No implementation code shown before plan approval

Prisma schema includes credentialId as Bytes @unique
Prisma schema includes counter as BigInt (not Int)
Prisma schema includes aaguid field (String)
User model gets passkeyUserId field (String, PII-free)

Auth endpoints are public (no guard required)
rpId configured from RP_ID environment variable (domain-only, no protocol)

BigInt(newCounter) conversion shown when writing counter updates after verification
Challenge deletion in both success and catch blocks (replay protection)
Backward compatibility: existing JWT login preserved
Unguarded registration endpoint would fail with 401 (auth boundary check)
